overallNotes: Eric Matthew Lang (b. 1986-11-09), Cincinnati OH. ISTJ. Cold-chain coordinator at Freestore Foodbank in nonprofit food-distribution logistics. Married to Danielle (library branch assistant), adopted daughter Maya (8), brother-in-law Trevor in basement until mid-2027. Arc spans 2025-01 to 2028-10: begins with full-life introduction, then household crowding strain with Trevor, work baseline assignment, pilot, major cooler-compressor crisis, recovery phase, system hardening into formal playbook, stress test validation, and eventual personal restoration (softball return, short trips, pet reconsideration). Core tension: methodical systems-builder versus easily overwhelmed by crowding and financial fragility. Key relationships: Patricia Hensley (work ally), Samuel Kline (blunt pantry-side validator), Marcus Avery (friend who nudges toward restoration). Recurring health theme: stress reflux managed through medication, symptom logs, breakfast changes, personal days. Major inflection points: Trevor's written agreement (2025-02), 90-day pilot approval after milk dump (2025-07), compressor failure (2026-05), Trevor moves out (2027-06), four-quarter target achievement (2027-08), playbook formalization (2028-01), heat-wave system stress test (2028-06). Financial fragility is a persistent undercurrent: AC repair, shed install, tax-refund emergency fund. Long arc: from personal vigilance/heroics to shared system/distributed responsibility, with measurable reduction in hypervigilance by 2028.
